issues.hint: These cubes have a large face with nothing on or near it — a bare flat wall (the named face is the worst one). Break it with an overlay, a bevel cube at 45 degrees, or a generate_array row.
The bone tree is only 2 deep. Segmented limbs and chains need root -> hips -> spine -> chest -> limb upper -> lower -> hand, i.e. 5+ levels. check_rig has the details.

recommendations: Break bare slabs with overlapping trim, 45-degree bevel cubes, or a fringe row.
note: Density is necessary, not sufficient: a high cube count with no layering still looks flat. Pair this with compare_reference (silhouette) and check_model (z-fighting, untextured faces).
